summary: Verified (1) status-tab counts on EVERY tab for Lembur, Kunjungan Sales, Galeri Desain (not just the active tab, and 'Semua' == total), and (2) 'Paling lama menunggu' summary card on Meja Saya / Meja MD / Meja Admin Gudang (my-desk-/md-desk-/wh-desk-oldest-* testids) with working Buka antrean + Buka dokumen tertua actions, and (3) no horizontal overflow on 390px mobile. All checks pass.
critical_code_review_comments: OvertimeView.jsx:88-94 fetches /hr/overtime twice per load() (once without `status` for counts, once with filters for rows). Fine for small data; consider adding a dedicated status-counts endpoint for parity with LeaveView.

VisitsView.jsx:61-63 fetches /hr/visits WITHOUT page/page_size for counts. Backend returns paginated envelope → statusCounts may understate when total > default page_size. Low risk right now (demo total=0) but should use ?page_size=10000 or a dedicated counts endpoint.

DesignGalleryView.jsx:82-84 computes gallery-filter-status counts client-side from `items` (already filtered to ACC statuses) — correct for current scope (3 ACC statuses + 'Semua'); not affected by current `f.status` selection so counts stay stable across tab switches.

RoleDesk.jsx:80-84 computes `oldestQ`/`oldestRow` from queues with count>0 — safe when no queue has items (card hidden). oldest-card uses flex-wrap so at 390px the two action buttons wrap under the label without overflow (verified: card_right=361, viewport=390, doc.scrollWidth=390).
seed_data_creation: Dynamic: POST 3 TEST_iter159 overtime requests (one approved, one rejected, one left pending) against ent_ksc; deleted all 3 directly from Mongo (collection hr_overtime, reason regex TEST_iter159) after count verification — 0 rows left.
